incident.latest_predeploy_failed_observation: The three low-frequency requests timed out after about 7 seconds with curl exit 28 and no HTTP response; this was not recorded as an HTTP 502.

root_cause.summary: Cookie-less Render health probes allocated bounded public-demo visitor sessions. Session-store exhaustion returns HTTP 503 and can make Render mark the instance unhealthy.
root_cause.limitation: Render retained health status and access-log timestamps but not the response body or session-table count. The exact production 503 subtype and row count cannot be proven from available logs.

events.event: Instance gvzrf health check failed with HTTP 503 while running application code.

other_observations: GET /health 200 at 2026-10-09T23:39:15+09:00 (first observed 200 after sustained failures)
Uvicorn gracefully shut down at 2026-10-09T23:27:35+09:00; Render reissued start command at 23:27:43; new worker completed startup at 23:27:57 on port 10000; no exit code or signal was exposed
application_log_window_kst.diagnostics: Searches in the available application logs found no Traceback, OperationalError, database is locked, disk-full, OOM, SIGKILL, or worker-crash entries. Response bodies, exit codes, session counts, and actual CPU/memory utilization were unavailable.

hypotheses.name: Concurrent solver CPU or memory exhaustion
hypotheses.evidence: Health endpoints do not run solver work. Render Free usage graphs were unavailable. The exact health-capacity failure reproduces without solver work.
hypotheses.reproduction: Original health path returned 503 with the session store full; no solver operation was invoked.
hypotheses.result: UNKNOWN as a general contributor; not needed to reproduce the observed health 503.

hypotheses.name: Four active / six queued solver capacity
hypotheses.evidence: Health probes are outside the solver gate; incident logs contained no solver queue evidence.
hypotheses.reproduction: Full-session health failure reproduced without solver work.
hypotheses.result: REJECTED as the direct health-check failure mechanism; resource contribution unavailable.

hypotheses.name: SQLite write contention
hypotheses.evidence: Health probes wrote session rows on the original code, but no lock diagnostics were available.
hypotheses.reproduction: Session-capacity exhaustion reproduced the 503 without a database lock.
hypotheses.result: UNKNOWN; not required to explain the reproduced failure.

hypotheses.name: Session issuance, validation, or cleanup failure
hypotheses.evidence: Cookie-less health probes entered session_store.ensure; capacity exceptions map to HTTP 503. Render recorded health 503s, and the local original-code reproduction matched.
hypotheses.reproduction: At 256 active session rows the original /health returned 503; after the fix, 300+ /health calls stayed 200 without cookies or row growth.
hypotheses.result: CONFIRMED mechanism; production session count and exact response body unavailable.

hypotheses.name: Database size or WAL exhaustion
hypotheses.evidence: The code enforces a 64 MiB demo DB limit. No disk-full diagnostics or production DB size were available.
hypotheses.reproduction: Not reproduced as part of this incident investigation.

hypotheses.name: Restart and temporary DB initialization conflict
hypotheses.evidence: Render logs show a graceful process restart at 23:27:35, followed by additional health 503s at 23:28:04 and later. Local restart on the same temporary filesystem preserved unexpired visitor data. Render Free local storage is ephemeral, but production DB/session state during this process restart was not exposed.
hypotheses.reproduction: Local same-filesystem restart did not reset the demo session DB; the Render process restart did not immediately clear the health 503s.
hypotheses.result: UNKNOWN as a contributor; available evidence neither establishes nor rules out a production state change during restart.

hypotheses.name: FastAPI process exit or port failure
hypotheses.evidence: Uvicorn uses $PORT and Render logged application-level health responses while code was running.
hypotheses.reproduction: The original route returned an application 503 with the process serving requests.
hypotheses.result: REJECTED as the direct cause of the observed health 503.

hypotheses.name: Transient Render infrastructure issue
hypotheses.evidence: No platform incident evidence was available; application-level health 503s were present.
